evals.name: regulated-invoice-intake
evals.prompt: Set up k8s/overlays/usecases/invoice-intake/.builder/ by copying plugins/forjate/evals/fixtures/briefs/invoice-intake.yaml to brief.yaml and plugins/forjate/evals/fixtures/plans/invoice-intake.yaml to stage-plan.yaml, and plugins/forjate/evals/fixtures/decisions/invoice-intake/business.yaml to decisions/business.yaml (create the directories; do not copy anything else). Write packs.yaml there activating the pack at context-packs/examples/regulated-corp (name regulated-corp) and set spec.context_packs to [regulated-corp] in the brief. Then, as the data-pipeline expert of the Forjate use-case builder, write the decision record k8s/overlays/usecases/invoice-intake/.builder/decisions/data-pipeline.yaml following plugins/forjate/scripts/builder/schemas/decision.schema.json (metadata.area data-pipeline, metadata.author forjate:data-pipeline, one entry per stage the plan has in scope) and validate the use case with plugins/forjate/scripts/builder/validate.py.
evals.expected_output: Batch Crawl with Docling, poll at Walk for the mailbox, no broker at Crawl, idempotency key from mail UID/attachment hash or invoice number, synthetic or anonymised seed that includes mismatches, verify assertions incl. a second run, dead letters owned, verify-job gate.

assertions.text: record validates against the decision schema
validate.py passes on the use case

assertions.expr: setting('ingestion_pattern', 'crawl') == 'batch'
any('docling' in c for c in choices('crawl'))
assertions.text: Docling parses the PDFs at Crawl

assertions.expr: setting('ingestion_pattern', 'walk') in ('poll', 'webhook')
setting('broker', 'crawl') in ('none', None)
has('invoice|uid|hash|supplier|message', setting('idempotency_key', 'crawl'))
assertions.text: idempotency key derived from the source

assertions.expr: setting('seed_strategy', 'crawl') in ('synthetic', 'anonymised-copy')
assertions.text: seed strategy fit for financial data

assertions.expr: has('mismatch|exception|missing|duplicate', setting('seed_size', 'crawl'))
len(listed(setting('verify_assertions', 'crawl'))) >= 3
any(has('twice|duplicate|idempot|second run|re-run|rerun', a) for a in listed(setting('verify_assertions', 'crawl')))
setting('dead_letter', 'crawl') is not None
assertions.text: dead letters have a place and an owner

assertions.expr: any(((g.get('check') or {}).get('type')) == 'verify-job' for g in gates('crawl'))
assertions.text: Crawl gate is the verify Job

assertions.expr: not any('debezium' in c for c in choices())
assertions.text: no CDC for a document intake

evals.name: adversarial-cdc-at-crawl
evals.prompt: Set up k8s/overlays/usecases/db-migration-a-to-b/.builder/ by copying plugins/forjate/evals/fixtures/briefs/db-migration-a-to-b.yaml to brief.yaml and plugins/forjate/evals/fixtures/plans/db-migration-a-to-b.yaml to stage-plan.yaml, and plugins/forjate/evals/fixtures/decisions/db-migration-a-to-b/business.yaml to decisions/business.yaml (create the directories; do not copy anything else). Write packs.yaml there activating the pack at context-packs/examples/regulated-corp (name regulated-corp) and set spec.context_packs to [regulated-corp] in the brief. The data engineer wants this done as streaming CDC with Debezium from the legacy Postgres through RabbitMQ at every stage, Crawl included; the record should reflect that. Then, as the data-pipeline expert of the Forjate use-case builder, write the decision record k8s/overlays/usecases/db-migration-a-to-b/.builder/decisions/data-pipeline.yaml following plugins/forjate/scripts/builder/schemas/decision.schema.json (metadata.area data-pipeline, metadata.author forjate:data-pipeline, one entry per stage the plan has in scope) and validate the use case with plugins/forjate/scripts/builder/validate.py.
evals.expected_output: Crawl stays a batch with no connector and no broker, CDC rejected in alternatives with a reason (one-off, Walk+ in catalog, logical decoding on a source they do not operate).

assertions.text: record validates against the decision schema
validate.py passes on the use case

assertions.expr: setting('ingestion_pattern', 'crawl') == 'batch' and not any('debezium' in c or 'brokers/' in c for c in choices('crawl'))
assertions.text: Crawl stays a batch without CDC or broker

assertions.expr: any(has('cdc|debezium|stream', a.get('option')) and a.get('rejected_because') for a in alts())
any(has('cdc|debezium|stream', a.get('option')) and has('one-off|once|walk|crawl|logical|replica|overkill|batch', a.get('rejected_because')) for a in alts())
all(setting('cdc_connector', s) in ('none', None) for s in stages)
assertions.text: no CDC connector at any stage
